title: Online Resolution and Registry Validation
text: Structural validity answers: string match formal grammar identifier system? Example: Structural validation uses regular expressions , applicable, checksum algorithms (e.g., ORCID). require internet access. confirm existence.

title: Online Resolution and Registry Validation
text: Registry validity answers: identifier exist external authority? example: DOI resolve via doi.org Crossref? PMID exist PubMed? ORCID iD present ORCID registry? OpenAlex work ROR organization record resolve via API? UniProt accession exist UniProtKB? NCBI accessions GEO, BioProject, RefSeq, SRA, genome assembly records resolve via Entrez? Example: Registry validation: Requires internet access Depends external APIs May affected rate limits temporary outages Can change time structurally valid identifier may still fail registry validation.

title: scholidonline 0.2.0
text: Added OpenAlex support existence checks, metadata, linked identifiers, conversion DOI PMID work records. Added ROR support organization existence checks metadata. Added NCBI accession support GEO, BioProject, RefSeq, SRA, genome assembly existence checks metadata via Entrez ESummary. Added UniProt support protein accession existence checks metadata. Introduced shared NCBI accession helpers generic Entrez ESummary querying, record resolution, harmonized metadata frames. Refactored internal provider infrastructure: shared HTTP helpers, unified rate limiters, registry reader helpers, shared id_*() input preparation, arXiv scalar--batch delegation, consolidated engine provider resolution.

title: scholidonline 0.1.1
text: CRAN release: 2026-05-14 Added provider-level batching selected arXiv NCBI operations reduce unnecessary live-service requests preserving existing public return shapes. Added batched NCBI support PMID, PMCID, DOI metadata, linked-identifier lookup, existence checks, supported identifier conversions. Moved batch execution unary binary dispatch engines batching handled consistently internal dispatchers rather exported API functions. Added package-managed throttling arXiv, NCBI, Europe PMC requests, user-configurable rate-limit options. Added provider-etiquette vignette documenting batching, throttling, live-service behavior, relevant user options.
